Proposal Figures

Map of public comments databases

Note: cant render with high res map version

```{r load packages}
library(ggOceanMaps)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(ggnewscale) #add a second scale on top of bathymetry 
```

```{r colors}

phillips_colors <- c("#AA4499","#882255","#CC6677","#DDCC77","#117733",
                     "#44AA99","#88CCEE","#332288","#302E2C","#808080")
phillips_colors_alpha <- alpha(phillips_colors, 0.5)

```

```{r making the map }

site_levels <- c("Orca Basin", "Chumash Heritage", "Morro Bay", "Wilkinson Basin")
site_colors       <- setNames(phillips_colors[1:4], site_levels)
site_colors_alpha <- setNames(phillips_colors_alpha[1:4], site_levels)

#Define the map window and spacing then add points
figure <- basemap(
  limits       = c(-130, -60, 20, 50),
  lon.interval = 10,
  lat.interval = 5,
  bathy.style  = "raster_continuous_blues", #high res
 # bathymetry   = TRUE, #low res 
  rotate       = FALSE
) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +   # start a new fill scale AFTER bathymetry is drawn
  geom_point(
    data = data.frame(
      site = factor(site_levels, levels = site_levels),
      lon  = c(-91.3333, -121.017, -121.45, -69.50),
      lat  = c(26.9167,   34.483,   35.32,   42.50)
    ),
    aes(
      x = lon,
      y = lat,
      shape = site,
      fill  = site,    # uses the new fill scale 
      color = site     
    ),
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Orca Basin"       = 21,
    "Chumash Heritage" = 22,
    "Morro Bay"        = 24,
    "Wilkinson Basin"  = 23
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = site_colors_alpha) +
  scale_color_manual(values = site_colors)

print(figure)
```

```{r}

site_levels <- c("Orca Basin", "Chumash Heritage", "Morro Bay", "Wilkinson Basin",
                 "Alaska OCS")
site_colors       <- setNames(phillips_colors[1:5], site_levels)
site_colors_alpha <- setNames(phillips_colors_alpha[1:5], site_levels)

# defining sites for mapping
base_sites <- data.frame(
  site = factor(site_levels[1:4], levels = site_levels),
  lon  = c(-91.3333, -121.017, -121.45, -69.50),
  lat  = c(26.9167, 34.483, 35.32, 42.50)
)

alaska_sites <- data.frame(
  site = factor(rep("Alaska OCS", 6), levels = site_levels),
  lon = c(-163.8, -162.2, -170.5, -150.0, -156.5, -147.5),
  lat = c(64.6, 59.3, 52.8, 73.0, 74.2, 56.3)
)

map_sites <- rbind(base_sites, alaska_sites)

# Define the map window and spacing then add points
figure <- basemap(
  limits       = c(-175, -60, 20, 80),
  lon.interval = 20,
  lat.interval = 10,
  bathy.style  = "raster_continuous_blues",
# bathymetry   = TRUE,
  rotate       = FALSE
) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  
# adding points
  geom_point(
  data = map_sites,
  aes(
    x = lon,
    y = lat,
    shape = site,
    fill = site,
    color = site
  ),
  size = 4,
  stroke = 1
) +

# Giving points symbols
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Orca Basin"       = 21,
    "Chumash Heritage" = 22,
    "Morro Bay"        = 24,
    "Wilkinson Basin"  = 23,
    "Alaska OCS"       = 25    
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = site_colors_alpha) +
  scale_color_manual(values = site_colors)

print(figure)
```

```{r print a PDF}

pdf("US_sites_bathymetry.pdf", width = 8, height = 6, onefile = TRUE)
print(figure)
dev.off()
```

```{r Wes figure}

# --- mCDR projects only for Wes ---
mCDR_levels <- c("LOC-NESS", "Carboniferous")
mCDR_colors       <- setNames(phillips_colors[1:2], mCDR_levels)
mCDR_colors_alpha <- setNames(phillips_colors_alpha[1:2], mCDR_levels)

mCDR_df <- data.frame(
  project = factor(mCDR_levels, levels = mCDR_levels),
  lon     = c(-91.3333, -69.50),  # LOC-NESS (Orca Basin), Carboniferous (Wilkinson Basin)
  lat     = c(26.9167,   42.50)
)

figure_mCDR <- basemap(
  limits       = c(-100, -60, 20, 50),   # tighter window for the two mCDR projects
  lon.interval = 10,
  lat.interval = 5,
  bathy.style  = "raster_continuous_blues",
  rotate       = FALSE
) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_point(
    data = mCDR_df,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, shape = project, fill = project, color = project),
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "LOC-NESS"       = 21,
    "Carboniferous"  = 23
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mCDR_colors_alpha) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mCDR_colors)

print(figure_mCDR)

pdf("mCDRsites.pdf", width = 6, height = 6, onefile = TRUE)
print(figure_mCDR)
dev.off()

```
